tactics.title: Tactics Library
tactics.description: Explore our collection of FM26 tactics — each with complete player roles, team instructions, and performance breakdown. Find the perfect system for your squad.
tactics.introText1: Welcome to the FM26 Tactics Library — the complete database of Football Manager 2026 tactics and formations. Every system below is broken down with full player roles, team instructions, and a performance overview, so you can find the best FM26 tactic for your squad. Whether you want to press high with a gegenpress, control games with tiki-taka, or frustrate opponents on the counter-attack, there is a proven blueprint here for every style of play.
tactics.introText2: New to the game? Start with the 4-2-3-1 gegenpress or the balanced 4-4-2 wing play — both are widely considered the best FM26 tactics for beginners. Experienced managers can explore the meta 4-3-3 systems or the deep 3-5-2 shapes, and every tactic page explains exactly how to set it up, which roles to use, and how the system performs against the FM26 match engine.
tactics.builderCtaText: Don't see the perfect system? Use our free interactive FM26 Tactic Builder to create a custom formation in minutes — place players, assign roles and duties, and export your tactic for Football Manager 2026.

best.strongWingersText: Use 4-2-3-1 or 4-3-3 DM Wide — your wingers will dominate the flanks.
best.stackedMidfieldText: Use 4-3-3 DM Wide (control) or 4-2-3-1 (attack) — overcrowd the middle third.

best.underdogText: Use 4-4-2 Counter or 5-3-2 — stay compact, frustrate, and counter-punch.
